title: Captain Marvel
desc: Amidst a mission, Vers, a Kree warrior, gets separated from her team and is stranded on Earth. However, her life takes an unusual turn after she teams up with Fury, a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

title: Elemental
desc: A determined man, Partha Sarathy, fights social injustice, climbs from tough streets to police, and battles a powerful Don and his criminal empire.

title: Predators (1987)
desc: Dutch and his team head to Central America to rescue hostages, but the mission turns deadly when they're hunted by a powerful alien warrior deep in the jungle.

title: The Maze Runner
desc: Teens trapped in a deadly labyrinth with shifting walls seek escape and truth. As alliances form and secrets emerge, they fight to survive and uncover a sinister purpose.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
desc: Thor is imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, and must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.

title: Snake In The Eagle's Shadow
desc: A boy who can't fight and is bullied by all, is trained in the art of kung-fu by an old man.

title: Avengers: End Game
desc: After Thanos wipes out half the universe, the Avengers reunite to rally their fallen allies and restore balance, embarking on an epic quest to save existence itself.

title: Darkroom
desc: Michelle takes a job recommended by her counselor that lands her trapped in a mansion with three psychotic siblings hell bent on purging Michelle of her sins.

title: Extraction
desc: When terrorists kidnap a retired CIA field operative, his son launches his own unsanctioned rescue operation.
